title: After School Program Medical Authorization Form
subtitle: An original operational medical authorization for after school program that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This After School Program Medical Authorization Form supports the complete after school program workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the After School Program Medical Authorization Form when the assigned after-school site lead needs one fillable record for student arrival, program participation, dismissal change, and authorized release without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: After school medical authorization identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this medical authorization to one student arrival, program participation, dismissal change, and authorized release record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: After school record reference
blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: After school scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: After school authorized health source and operating scope
sections.guidance: Transcribe supplied directions exactly and keep diagnosis or clinical interpretation out of this record.

blocks.label: Authorization and qualified source
After school supplied health and response information
items: Guardian-supplied health or support-plan reference
Qualified reviewer and effective program period
Medication, allergy, snack, mobility, activity, or participation limitation
Authorized medication or emergency supply custody location
Symptoms, response steps, and stop conditions from the approved plan
Guardian, school, and emergency response route
Private record location and minimum-necessary staff access
Update, expiration, dismissal, and guardian handoff requirement

blocks.label: Authorized item, exact supplied direction, applicability, source, and review
Medical and authorization boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records after-school operations; it does not change a school's dismissal authority, decide custody, diagnose a student, grant blanket consent, or replace emergency services. Stop participation or departure when identity, attendance, guardian direction, authorized release, health support, or safety is unresolved. Limit sensitive information and route decisions to qualified authorized staff.

sections.title: After school custody, staff readiness, and read-back
sections.guidance: Confirm the approved source, staff authority, setting, storage, and handoff before use.

blocks.label: Custody and authorized operating route
After school authorization readiness
items: Student is assigned to the correct site, group, and schedule
School dismissal-to-program transfer route is documented
Guardian and emergency contact routes are current
Authorized pickup, independent departure, or transport plan is visible
Unscheduled absence and non-arrival follow-up route is defined
Snack, allergy, medication, and health-plan references are privately routed
Academic, accessibility, language, sensory, or behavioral supports are routed
Staff coverage, room, activity, and headcount assignments are known
Late pickup, early release, and dismissal-change controls are available
Open participation conditions have owners and due points

blocks.label: Item or record custody, condition, count, owner, and evidence
Exact read-back, unresolved mismatch, staff limitation, and qualified-review question

fields.label: Read-back, mismatch, staff limitation, and review question

sections.title: After school response conditions, stop controls, and decision
sections.guidance: Do not guess or improvise; stop and use the documented escalation route on any mismatch.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring hold, stop, or escalation
items: Student expected from school does not arrive
Student arrives but is not on the program roster
Dismissal, transport, pickup, or independent-departure plan changed
Authorized person or guardian direction cannot be confirmed
Required medication, allergy, meal, or support route is unavailable
Student is missing, ill, injured, or in immediate distress
Staffing, room, weather, transport, or school closure changes operations
Attendance, headcount, schedule, or release record does not reconcile

blocks.label: Condition, observed fact, immediate action, contact, and outcome
After school operating decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the school or program administrator, guardian, and qualified health or support reviewer.

blocks.label: Decision basis, source consulted, temporary limit, and next qualified review

fields.label: Decision basis, source, temporary limit, and qualified review

sections.title: After school exceptions, notification, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Preserve unknowns, assign correction, and record the accountable recipient.

blocks.label: Authorization and response exceptions
items: Student arrival or participation cannot be confirmed
Guardian, emergency contact, or dismissal route is incomplete
Health, allergy, medication, snack, or support review is pending
Staffing, room, transport, or school handoff is unresolved
Immediate missing-student, illness, injury, or safety response is active
Departure, attendance, or daily closeout remains unresolved

blocks.label: Exception, evidence or action needed, owner, due point, and disposition
Guardian, qualified reviewer, emergency, program, and receiving-staff notification handoff

fields.label: Notification sequence, facts shared, instructions received, and handoff

sections.title: After school outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: After school closeout controls
items: Final attendance and remaining-student count accepted
Guardian communication and dismissal status recorded
Unresolved incident, academic, or support action has an owner
Equipment and private records returned to approved custody
School, transport, facilities, or health follow-up linked
Program record stored with access and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome and next action
Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Medical Authorization closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
